description: One link that opens a sportsbook with several legs on the bet slip. Pass PropLine outcome ids (the outcome_id on propline_get_best_line price rows with include_links=true), 1-12, all at one book: DraftKings, FanDuel or Fanatics. Returns bet_link plus each leg's book ids. The link only LOADS the legs; the book may still refuse to combine them (some same-game parlays), so tell the user to check the slip. No prices; every tier.
name: propline_get_parlay_link
title: Get multi-leg bet-slip link
